name: pickled-claude-plugins
description: Personal plugins marketplace for Josh Nichols

plugins.name: cq
plugins.description: Query past Claude Code sessions via the cq CLI (SQL over session transcripts)

plugins.name: petri-dish
plugins.description: Author Claude Code experiments (petri-dish cultures) with disciplined schema, baselines, and multi-run averaging

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Tailscale CLI reference and safe patterns for exposing local services over a tailnet

plugins.name: come-on
plugins.description: Catch Claude stopping short: unchecked claims, giving up early, inherited conclusions, unresearched options, and replies that don't land

plugins.name: wait-for-it
plugins.description: Turn "tell me when X happens" into a zero-token shell watch instead of a prompt loop

plugins.name: automic-vault
plugins.description: Teach agents what Automic Vault (av) is and how to use it as the credential manager: inject secrets, read approval history, and diagnose sandbox, locked-Mac and refused-agent errors

plugins.name: woodpecker
plugins.description: Investigate failed Woodpecker CI pipelines through woodpecker-cli (state, step states, first failed step log tail) and author .woodpecker.yml

plugins.name: hk
plugins.description: Auto-wire hk's coding-agent integration (Stop check, SessionStart instructions, MCP server) in projects that have an hk config

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Detects and reverts agent writes to git internals (exec config keys, hooks, redirects) (pure core; hooks not wired yet)
